title: Skills & Competencies
text:
Investment Appraisal & Capital Budgeting: Skilled in evaluating project feasibility using NPV, IRR, Payback Period, Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), and multi-scenario sensitivity testing.
Financial Modelling: Experienced in building structured, assumption-driven Excel models incorporating revenue forecasting, cost structures, cash-flow projections, and valuation metrics.
Budget Development & Variance Analysis: Ability to create annual and project-based budgets, track performance, identify cost deviations, and recommend optimization strategies.
Risk & Sensitivity Assessment: Adept at analyzing uncertainties across operating, financial, and market variables to support informed managerial decision-making.
Business Performance Evaluation: Capable of interpreting financial statements, KPI dashboards, and operational metrics to assess profitability and efficiency.

title: Welcome
text:
👋 Hello — I’m Priya Pathak

MBA Candidate | Finance & Business Analytics
I am an MBA candidate at University Canada West, specializing in Finance and Business Analytics, driven by a passion for turning data-driven insights into real business impact. Coming from a background where analytical thinking and ethical decision-making were always valued, I’ve grown into someone who thrives in structured problem-solving and meaningful decision-making.
I started my journey with a strong interest in understanding how businesses create value — and over time, finance, forecasting, and cost optimization became the areas where I found both challenge and purpose. As a parent and a full-time student, my experiences have shaped my resilience, discipline, and ability to manage complexity with clarity and calm.
Today, I am building my career at the intersection of finance, analytics, and technology, where numbers tell stories and strategy creates transformation. I’m particularly drawn to roles that allow me to analyze performance, improve efficiency, and support data-informed decisions that contribute to long-term growth.
Outside academics, I value simplicity, continuous learning, and creative thinking — qualities that help me connect business problems with practical, real-world solutions. My goal is to grow into a finance and analytics professional who contributes to sustainable, thoughtful, and effective business decisions.
